name: part1
hook: Why is the AI industry trying to leave the planet?
post: Google is sending four of its AI chips into orbit. Last December a satellite the size of a fridge trained an AI model in space. Part 1 of 4. #ai #space #google #spacex #datacenter #satellites #energy #tech #bigmac #thecurve

name: part2
hook: Mills followed rivers. Computers follow electricity.
post: Data centres already use about 1.5% of the world's electricity, heading for about all of Japan's by 2030. In orbit, a panel can collect up to 8x the energy. Part 2 of 4. #ai #space #google #spacex #datacenter #satellites #energy #tech #bigmac #thecurve

name: part3
hook: SpaceX has asked to launch up to a million satellites
post: There are about 16,500 working satellites today. The catch is the ticket: about $7,000 a kilo to orbit. Part 3 of 4. #ai #space #google #spacex #datacenter #satellites #energy #tech #bigmac #thecurve

name: part4
post: Every age builds its machines next to its power: the river, the coal field, the reactor. Now, maybe, the sun. Part 4 of 4. #ai #space #google #spacex #datacenter #satellites #energy #tech #bigmac #thecurve

name: bigmac
hook: Sending one Big Mac to space costs about 250 Big Macs
post: A SpaceX rideshare to orbit costs about $7,000 a kilo. A Big Mac weighs 219 g. So launching one costs about $1,500, or about 250 Big Macs at $6.22. #ai #space #google #spacex #datacenter #satellites #energy #tech #bigmac #thecurve

name: million
hook: SpaceX wants a million satellites. There are 16,500 today.
post: Starcloud has filed for 88,000 satellites, SpaceX for up to 1,000,000, all to put AI data centres in orbit. About 16,500 satellites work today, from every country. #ai #space #google #spacex #datacenter #satellites #energy #tech #bigmac #thecurve

name: suncatcher
hook: Google is putting its AI chips into orbit
post: Project Suncatcher: a satellite with four Google TPUs, set to launch on a Falcon 9 on 1 October 2026. The test is simple: do they survive up there? #ai #space #google #spacex #datacenter #satellites #energy #tech #bigmac #thecurve

name: shakespeare
hook: A satellite trained an AI model in space. On Shakespeare.
post: December 2025: Starcloud-1, a satellite about the size of a small fridge, trained an AI model in orbit on one Nvidia H100. #ai #space #google #spacex #datacenter #satellites #energy #tech #bigmac #thecurve

name: japan
hook: By 2030, AI's data centres could use as much power as Japan
post: Data centres used about 1.5% of the world's electricity in 2024. By 2030 the IEA expects about 945 TWh, roughly Japan's whole consumption. Microsoft is restarting a reactor at Three Mile Island. #ai #space #google #spacex #datacenter #satellites #energy #tech #bigmac #thecurve

name: sunlight
hook: What if the biggest computer on Earth wasn't on Earth?
post: Imagine 2040: a ring of satellites in permanent daylight, in no country. Not a forecast, a what-if. Under the 1967 treaty no one owns space, but every country answers for what it launches. #ai #space #google #spacex #datacenter #satellites #energy #tech #bigmac #thecurve
